thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 12/28/2018: QTM, ABIL, QUIK, MSFT, AAPL, CSCO, IBM, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 12/28/2018: QTM, ABIL, QUIK, MSFT, AAPL, CSCO, IBM, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +0.62%
AAPL: +0.69%
IBM: +0.45%
CSCO: Flat
GOOG: +0.29%
Technology stocks were inching higher pre-market Friday.
Stocks moving on news include:
(+) Quantum ( QTM ), which was surging by more than 43% after completing the refinancing of its current debt facilities, with the new $210 million of total credit facilities comprising $165 million senior secured term loan facility and a $45 million revolving credit line.
(+) Ability Inc. ( ABIL ) was gaining more than 35% as the Tel Aviv-based cyber intelligence software company said its founders have agreed to convert the company's NIS5.5 million ($1.5 million) credit line into equity.
In other sector news:
(=) QuickLogic ( QUIK ) was unchanged as it amended a loan and security agreement with Heritage Bank of Commerce to increase the revolving line of credit from $9 million to $15 million.
